mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, c.name AS category_name, s.name AS supplier_name FROM ingredient i LEFT JOIN ingredient_category c ON i.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON i.supplier_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE i.name = #{name} ORDER BY i.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingredient(name, category_id, supplier_id, spec, price, unit, price_unit, weight_per_unit, updated_at) VALUES(#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{supplierId}, #{spec}, #{price}, #{unit}, #{priceUnit}, #{weightPerUnit}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredient SET name=#{name}, category_id=#{categoryId}, supplier_id=#{supplierId}, spec=#{spec}, price=#{price}, unit=#{unit}, price_unit=#{priceUnit}, weight_per_unit=#{weightPerUnit}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ingredient SET price=#{price}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ingredient WHERE id IN #{id}
